title: 比特币展望2030：资管机构看多至40万至50万美元区间
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Digital assets have reclaimed $3 trillion in market value for the first time going back to January.
segments.zh: 数字资产市值重回3万亿美元，为1月以来首次。

segments.en: Bitcoin sitting just now above $86,000 per Bitcoin.
segments.zh: 比特币目前位于每枚86,000美元上方。

segments.en: Strives CEO Matt Colerites, our base case for Bitcoin through 2030 is 50% compound annual growth rate.
segments.zh: Strive CEO Matt Cole表示，我们对2030年前比特币的基准预测是50%的年复合增长率。

segments.en: We believe that is conservative. Joining us for an exclusive is Matt himself. Matt, why is 50% compound annual growth rate conservative for Bitcoin?
segments.zh: 我们认为这偏保守。Matt今天独家做客。Matt，为什么50%的年复合增长率对比特币来说算保守？

segments.en: First good to see you, there's really two reasons and so one of them is a backward looking metric.
segments.zh: 首先很高兴见到你，主要有两个原因，其中一个是回顾性指标。

segments.en: So looking at Bitcoin and every historical bull run off of its 200 week moving average.
segments.zh: 观察比特币，以及历史上每次从200周移动均线启动的牛市。

segments.en: And so obviously right now Bitcoin is already off of its 200 week moving average.
segments.zh: 显然，目前比特币已经脱离了200周移动均线。

segments.en: But when it goes off of its 200 week moving average into a bull market, the annual cager for the next three to four years looking forward has never been less than 60%.
segments.zh: 但当它脱离200周移动均线进入牛市时，未来三到四年的年化收益率从未低于60%。

segments.en: And so we adjusted that slightly, given that it's already above its 200 week moving average.
segments.zh: 考虑到它已经高于200周移动均线，我们略微调整了该预测。

segments.en: But the more important thing, because the past is not always indicative of the future, is what is this current macro setup look like?
segments.zh: 但更重要的是，因为过去并不总能预示未来，当前宏观环境如何？

segments.en: And how does it compare to, as an example, the 2022-2023 bear market into the 2024-2025 bull market?
